title: P19: MediaType parameter_value is RFC 5322 quoted-string content
description: mls-extensions-10 §6.2.2 stores a parameter value with quotes and quoted-pair backslashes removed, so a token-only rule (RFC 2045) contradicts it. Readings: (a) RFC 822 quoted-pair (any ASCII incl. NUL/CR/LF); (b) RFC 5322 §3.2.4 (cited by ext-10 §8): VCHAR/WSP, i.e. %x09 / %x20-7E, possibly empty; (c) token only. Chosen: (b). Rationale: matches the reference ext-10 itself cites; excludes NUL and CR/LF injection.
